claim: Apple reports no less than $81.1B in revenue for Q1 2025
summary: Apple's reported revenue for Q1 2025 exceeds $81.1B under either fiscal or calendar interpretation. Fiscal Q1 2025 (Dec 2024 quarter, reported Jan 30 2025) was ~$124.3B, and calendar Q1 2025 (Fiscal Q2 2025, reported May 1 2025) was ~$95.4B, both well above the $81.1B threshold. Claim of no less than $81.1B is therefore supported.
